name: com.fuji97.appflow
description: App-level state machine (Splash, MainMenu, Game, ...) authored as a Graph Toolkit graph (.appflow): per-state behaviours and features (scene loading, ...), default flow, parallel phase groups and custom transitions.

samples.description: UI Toolkit showcase: Splash > Main menu > Settings / Credits / Game > Pause, with default flow, parallel phase groups and custom transitions. After import: add the sample's Scenes/*.unity to the Build Profile scene list, open Scenes/Boot.unity, press Play.
